messages:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: we need one canonical external summary + clear RCA-sharing rules. This keeps customers consistent and reduces repeated asks.

ciaran: Agreed. Recommendation: status page blurb + 2-line FAQ. Offer redacted RCA to SLA customers on request; public RCA only for severity >= SEV2 or repeated incidents.

legal: Two requirements: 1) Confirm no customer data was exposed before publishing, 2) use the term 'redacted root cause analysis' for enterprise requests.

samir: Ops update: short-term mitigations applied (burst nodes, tuned TTL). INF-5350 tracks the long-term fix, ETA ~2 weeks.

product-comms: I can draft the status copy. Timeline: draft by Thu EOD, legal review within 24h, publish 48-72h after approval.

customer-success: We'll prepare the SLA outreach list and a template offer for a 1:1 review.

ops-bot: Created ticket COMMS-1417 and linked INF-5350. Reminder set for 2026-04-01 to verify progress.

maya: Action recap (please paste into postmortem tracker):
- product-comms: Draft status page blurb + 2-line FAQ (due: 2026-03-28) [owner: product-comms]
- samir: Post remediation ETA + weekly updates to INF-5350 (due: 2026-04-12) [owner: samir]
- legal: Confirm PII/no-exposure statement after forensic sign-off (due: 24h after draft) [owner: legal]
- customer-success: Prepare SLA outreach list + email draft (due: 2026-03-30) [owner: customer-success]

Please update this thread when items are done so we can close the loop. Thanks :thumbsup:
